criteria.name: CSV and Parquet imports profile successfully
criteria.evidence: tests_agent.test_desktop_dataset_import_gate validates both formats through the desktop RPC contract.

criteria.name: Malformed input is rejected
criteria.evidence: The same test covers empty CSV, a structurally malformed UTF-8 CSV, and a non-UTF-8 CSV.

criteria.name: Duplicate dataset hash is deduplicated
criteria.evidence: Two load_dataset calls for one source produce exactly one SQLite datasets row.

criteria.name: Million-row preview stays bounded
criteria.evidence: A 1,000,000 row synthetic CSV returns schema plus no more than 50 sample rows and no rows payload.

criteria.name: Desktop file selection and native drop are safe
criteria.evidence: DatasetImportPage Vitest cases cover picker cancellation and a native dropped file path followed by bounded preflight.

criteria.name: Production frontend builds
criteria.evidence: npm --prefix desktop run build completed after the import UI changes.
